title: Fintech Lending Analytics
thesis: Snowflake enables financial inclusion through alternative credit scoring — Dynamic Tables maintain real-time loan portfolios, ML.FORECAST projects default probability, and Cortex AI generates personalized collection and disbursement strategies

talking_points: Rp 18 trillion outstanding across 3 million borrowers — 92% previously unbanked.
NPL ratio at 4.2% — within OJK 5% threshold but trending up 40bps.
Collection efficiency at 87% — best in class among OJK-registered P2P platforms.
